title: Traveler's Tree
description: The traveler's tree (Ravenala madagascariensis) is native to Madagascar. Despite its name, the tree is not considered a true palm tree but rather a giant flowering plant. The image is part of photographer Charlotte Yonga's project, "(Tsy) Possible," which documents how intimacy is shaped by the social and geographical landscape of Madagascar. The title combines "tsy," which means "no" in the country's primary language of Malagasy, with the French word "possible."
translated_description: 旅人树（学名：Ravenala madagascariensis）原产于马达加斯加。尽管名称如此，这种树并非真正的棕榈树，而是一种大型开花植物。这张照片出自摄影师夏洛特·扬加的项目《(Tsy) Possible》，该项目记录了亲密关系如何被马达加斯加的社会与地理风貌所塑造。标题将马达加斯加主要语言马尔加什语中意为"不"的"tsy"与法语单词"possible"结合而成。
